claim_scope: Internal managed matmul implementation for the six declared signatures through a trusted, source-bound SimX/native-RTL runner. Actual acceptance requires retained execution and lifecycle evidence; the pure planner still performs no dispatch.

profile.address_bits_scope: ISA/address representation width, not proof of the device's physical or virtual address aperture.
profile.profile_attestation_scope: The trusted execution runner separately validates runtime/backend/kernel/host compiler records, hashes exact build artifacts, selects the corresponding runtime path, and binds those identities to each launch. The wrapper loads the supplied module bytes and verifies queried device geometry. This is not authentication of arbitrary hardware.

signature.aliasing: All three accessed byte ranges must be pairwise disjoint; consistent disjoint subviews of one allocation are permitted.
signature.numerics: The accepted P02 TFR ordered four-product reductions, RNE, exceptional values and signed output FTZ contract; no new arithmetic or tolerance is introduced.

operators.reason: No vector signature or dispatch has been qualified.
Axes, reduction order and numerical behavior remain to be frozen.
No stable reduction/exp signature or launch wrapper has been qualified.
No normalization formula, epsilon or parameter signature has been qualified.
No activation function signature or launch wrapper has been qualified.
Layout conversion and dtype casts are not implicit; their numerical and aliasing contracts remain to be frozen.
No reusable attention signature, masking contract or launch wrapper has been qualified.

argument_abi.range_rule: Every accessed byte, including the last byte, must be representable. A last byte at the maximum address is valid for encoding; no wrapped end calculation or truncation is allowed. This does not establish actual device addressability or a valid mapping.

allocation_contract.metadata_source: Caller-owned allocation registry with nonzero stable device/allocation IDs; not arbitrary unverified handle metadata.
allocation_contract.extent: Entire recorded allocation and accessed subrange must fit the ISA/address representation width; offset plus required bytes must fit the recorded allocation extent.
allocation_contract.actual_addressability: Before dispatch, the allocation registry and qualified profile binding must separately establish that the device aperture and valid physical/virtual mappings cover the entire recorded allocation. RV64 representation does not imply 64 physical address bits.
allocation_contract.same_allocation_id: All base-address, extent, device and permission metadata must agree.

failure_semantics.output: Unchanged on every failure; publish a fully constructed plan or byte block only on success.

next_implementation: P03-T02 is accepted for the six declared signatures. P04-T01 next freezes a redistributable tiny-model fixture composed from accepted operators; new operators or broader signatures require separate review and qualification.
